body: Roles kept separate: UI goal (target picture, now 'Design a simple, independent planning UI', fp.dev visual direction, Jira workflows only), review goal (process), UI plan (execution order), review plan (cadence). No duplicate links remain; no parents or blocks changed; edits went through the revision-checked document API. pman validate passes.
